Electron\ Ion microscopy: FESEM (JEOL JSM-IT500HR/LV)
equipment
Institute of Materials Research and Engineering (IMRE)
2 Fusionopolis Way, Innovis, #08-03 Singapore 138634
 What is it? 
 This field emission scanning electron microscope is equipped with 2 configurations: 1) for high and low vacuum image observation, 2) also includes an integrated Aztec EBSD system.
 Manufacturer: JEOL
 Model Name: JSM-IT500HR/LV
 Applications: High resolution imaging with zeromag function (seamless transition from CCD image to high-resolution SEM image, together with Oxford’s Symmetry (CMOS) EBSD detector. 
 Instrument Overview: Collecting high-magnification images even at analytical conditions or low accelerating voltages with integrated data management software: SMILE VIEW™ Lab. This SEM is equipped with Low Vacuum function as well, which allows observation of insulating materials without conductive coating (e.g. Gold, Platinum).
 Technical features and specifications: 
 Resolution High vacuum mode 1.5 nm (30 kV), 4.0 nm (1.0 kV) Low vacuum mode 3.0 nm (15 kV, Probe current : 1 nA) Low vacuum mode 1.8 nm (15 kV, BED) Direct magnification: ×5 to ×600,000 (print size of 128 mm × 96 mm) Displayed magnification: ×14 to ×1,679,449 (on the monitor) (Display size of 358 mm × 269 mm) Electron gun: High brightness electron gun Accelerating voltage: 0.5 kV to 30 kV Probe current: 1 pA to 20 nA LV pressure adjustment: 10 to 150 Pa Aperture angle control lens: Built-in Objective lens aperture: 4-stage, with XY fine adjustment function Automatic functions: Automatic beam alignment Focus /Stigmator /Brightness /Contrast Maximum specimen size 200 mm dia. × 75 mm height 200 mm dia. × 80 mm height *1 32 mm dia. × 90 mm height *1 Specimen stage: Large eucentric stage (X : 125 mm, Y : 100 mm, Z : 80 mm; Tilt : –10 to 90°, Rotation : 360°) Montage functio: Built-in as standard Measurement-position coordinate display: 200 mm dia. Standard recipes: Built-in (includes EDS condition *2) Image mode: Secondary electron image, REF image, Composition image, Topographic image, Stereo-microscopic image Pixels for image aquisiton: 640 × 480, 1,280 × 960, 2,560 × 1,920, 5,120 × 3,840 OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10 64bit Observation monitor: 24-inch touch panel Measurement functions: Built-in (distance between 2 points, distance between parallel lines, angle, diameter, etc.) Data management Report generation SMILE VIEWTM Lab Single-click report Output to Microsoft® Word、 Microsoft® PowerPoint *3 Language switch: Operable on UI (Japanese/English) Vacuum system: Fully automatic, TMP : 1, SIP : 2, RP：2 br> 
 Charges:
 NA
 Instrument Manufacturer URL: N.A.
